source_review.notes: Checked IEC 60812:2018 and its stability date; active 2024 NASA GSFC-HDBK-8004; current NASA Software Engineering Handbook guidance; the authoritative DLA ASSIST cancellation record for MIL-STD-1629A and current DI-SESS-81495 Revision C record; current FDA human-factors guidance and recognized-standards database; NASA FMEA bibliography and Systems Engineering Handbook; and the SAE J1739_202101 record. All ten final URLs returned HTTP 200. The cancelled historical military standard is explicitly distinguished from current requirements.

evidence: Reviewed the FMEA row tuple over item, function, mode, cause, three effect levels, controls, rankings, actions, verification and residual assessment.
Reviewed historical mode and item criticality expressions with dimensions and declared parameters.
Reviewed consequence-aware priority as a policy function rather than a universal scalar formula.
Reviewed function/mode/cause/effect and control-credit notation.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The chapter keeps ordinal ranks, rate-based criticality and risk acceptance conceptually distinct.

evidence: Executed fmea-ranking-fixture under python3 with exact output recorded in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-061/report.json.
Recomputed displayed RPN values 108, 280, 160, 140 and 216 from the five declared triples.
Confirmed the explicit policy selects four high-priority rows and each has an owned action.
Confirmed four verified actions and residual displayed products 36, 105, 64, 60 and 216, with the unverified fifth row unchanged.
Recomputed worked criticality examples as 0.0002 and 0.0012 under their stated constant-rate models.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Arithmetic correctness does not validate ordinal multiplication, input rankings, failure-rate assumptions, controls or product acceptability.

evidence: Confirmed mode criticality is dimensionless when failure rate is inverse time, mission duration is time and alpha/beta are dimensionless.
Confirmed item criticality summation is conditional on compatible mode/severity definitions and assumptions.
Confirmed control credit requires implementation, applicability, timeliness, sufficient independence and verification.
Confirmed the row argument preserves context, mode, propagation, control, priority, action, verification and residual disposition as separate obligations.
Confirmed identical RPN products need not imply equal consequence, priority, treatment or authority.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No probability or completeness claim is inferred from an RPN, qualitative category or historical criticality approximation.

evidence: Challenged missing functions, cause/mode/effect confusion, shallow propagation, repeated generic effects and invalid score changes.
Reviewed nominal/degraded/startup/shutdown modes, environment, timing, intermittent and dormant faults, interfaces and serial/lot effectivity.
Reviewed redundancy with shared power, sensor, software, environment, maintenance, switching and diagnostic dependencies.
Reviewed software omission/commission/value/order/timing/state/resource/update modes without inappropriate wear-rate assumptions.
Reviewed human task, foreseeable misuse, feedback, representative users and weak training/warning controls without blame language.
Reviewed planned versus verified controls, late detection, false behavior, inspection versus prevention, action-created modes and residual acceptance.
Reviewed supplier opacity, field population/exposure, censored evidence, rate applicability, mode fractions, constant-rate and dependency limits.
Reviewed all ten examples and five complete answers for assumptions, intermediate reasoning, evidence limits and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Production FMEA still requires appropriate domain, reliability, safety, software, hardware, process, human-factors, test, supplier, configuration and decision-authority participation.

evidence: Confirmed scope, configuration, use/mission profile, criteria and acceptance authority precede scoring.
Confirmed required function and performance limits precede failure-mode derivation.
Confirmed cause, mode and local/next/end effects remain distinct throughout.
Confirmed severity and mandatory safety action cannot be compensated away by occurrence/detection products.
Confirmed action proposal, implementation, verification, residual assessment and acceptance remain separate states.
Confirmed lifecycle updates preserve prior baselines and connect test/field evidence to affected configurations.
Confirmed complementary methods are required for top-down, combination, common-cause, sequence and adversarial concerns.
invariant_checking.notes: FMEA is consistently presented as bounded bottom-up evidence, not proof of reliability, safety, security or completeness.

proof_review.notes: The chapter presents calculation models and an evidence argument but no theorem proof.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: The executable fixture labels its evidence synthetic_rankings_only and enumerates what it does not validate.
Historical criticality calculations are bounded by rare-event/constant-rate and data-applicability assumptions.
Current versus historical/cancelled source status is explicit.
Field observations are treated with population, exposure, configuration and censoring limits.
No external review, method completeness, control effectiveness, reliability, safety, compliance or product acceptance is claimed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Empirical and quantitative statements remain tied to declared fixtures, source records or conditional models.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked failure, mode, cause/mechanism, local/next/end effect, DFMEA/PFMEA, software/use analysis, prevention/detection/containment/mitigation/recovery, severity/occurrence/detection, RPN, FMECA, single point and residual risk.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked planning, team, decomposition, functional derivation, propagation, control evidence, ranking criteria, RPN and criticality limits, action design, closure, interfaces, software, use/process, complementary methods, configuration/provenance and field feedback.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from row semantics and planning through ranking, treatment and lifecycle maintenance. Ten examples isolate recurring defects; five complete solutions cover cross-domain rows, RPN critique, criticality recomputation, dependency-aware redundancy and field-driven revision.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external IEC/NASA/DLA/FDA/SAE expert, reliability statistician, domain designer, software/process/human-factors engineer, operator/maintainer, supplier, test, quality, cybersecurity, hazard/safety, common-cause, independent V&V, certification, technical-authority or residual-risk acceptance review is claimed.
